back_translation: I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, four horns.
So I asked the angel who was speaking with me, “What are these?” He answered me, “These are the horns that gored Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem and scattered them.”
Then the LORD showed me four craftsmen.

So I asked, “What are these coming to do?” He answered, “These are the horns that scattered Judah so that no one could lift his head; but these craftsmen have come to terrify them and to cast down the horns of the nations that lifted up their horns against the land of Judah to scatter it.”
I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
So I asked, “Where are you going?” He answered me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see how wide and how long it is.”
And behold, the angel who was speaking with me went out, and another angel came out to meet him,
and the first angel said to him, “Run, tell that young man: Jerusalem will be a city without walls, because of the multitude of people and livestock within it.”
“For I will be a wall of fire around it,” declares the LORD, “and I will be the glory within it.”
“Get up! Get up! Flee from the land of the north,” declares the LORD, “for I have scattered you like the four winds of heaven,” declares the LORD.
“O Zion, escape for your life, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon!”
For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “After his glory was shown, he sent me to the nations that plundered you, for whoever touches you touches the apple of his eye.”
“For behold, I will wave my hand over them, and they will become plunder for their own servants.” Then you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent me.
“Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion, for behold, I am coming, and I will dwell in your midst,” declares the LORD.
“On that day many nations will join themselves to the LORD and will become my people, and I will dwell in your midst.” Then you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent me to you.
The LORD will take possession of Judah as his portion in the holy land, and he will again choose Jerusalem.
Be silent, all flesh, before the LORD, for he has roused himself from his holy dwelling.
